notes.what: Sight-to-shot Stage S1 standby (A) rule, PLAN-r10 R9-3 as relabelled by R10-2. Chosen a priori from code and encoding facts, no session data. notes.deflection: SHARED (A)/(E). Right-stick Chebyshev deflection from centre 128, clipped 127; same encoding as defl() in src/humanlike.rs:56.
notes.onset_d: (A) only; (E) tunes it. 26 (~20% of 127) is a design choice, not a measured CoD deadzone (CoD's deadzone is UNKNOWN and not used).
notes.release_d: (A) only; (E) tunes it. 13 (~10% of 127) is a design choice; also the quiet level.
notes.quiet_us: (A) only; (E) tunes it. Q = 100 ms is a design choice.
notes.window_us: SHARED (A)/(E). W = 1.5 s is a design choice (r1's example value).
notes.edge_delta: SHARED (A)/(E). R2 edge = analog jump > 60 between consecutive in rows, exactly sidecar trigger_edges() (sidecar/qorcap_cod.py:526-540) with TRIGGER_DELTA = 60 (:62), the same trigger step src/haptics.rs:149 treats as a change. The R2 digital bit is a diagnostic only and never makes an edge; a slow squeeze makes no edge.
notes.burst_gap_us: SHARED (A)/(E). B = 250 ms is a design choice.
notes.onset_rule: SHARED (A)/(E). Rule (ii): the first onset after a quiet span >= Q inside the window.
notes.max_rx_gap_us: hb gate from PLAN section 2.3 (50,000 us).
notes.min_bursts_for_headline: M4 floor, borrowed (LAG_MIN_SAMPLES = 30), not statistically derived.
